The upgrade covers backup power, failover capability, and core infrastructure reliability. Before I can finalize the authorization and release funds, I need us to go through our standard review -- tax classification, operational risk allocation, and supplier release terms all need to be recorded. Let's start working through each of those areas so we can move this forward.
